text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume from Sweep Tosho's generation 
was troubled, unable to take the first 
step toward trying again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy said that thanks to Sweep 
Tosho's magic, her resignation vanished, 
allowing her to find courage. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I watched the Takarazuka Kinen on TV, 
I felt like I couldn't stand in the same 
place as Sweep Tosho anymore. It felt as 
if an invisible wall stood between us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the feeling of frustration 
wouldn't go away. ...Could it be that she, 
too, deep down, wished for Sweep Tosho to 
cast magic on her?
